entries.final_answer: Report only: list deprecations and new entries in the PR body for the reviewer; edit prices only (recommended)
options: Report only: list deprecations and new entries in the PR body for the reviewer; edit prices only (recommended)
Edit retirements: remove a retired entry from the catalog; report new entries only
Edit both: remove retired entries and add new entries with placeholder editorial fields
entries.question: When a source shows a catalog entry is deprecated/retired, or the catalog's provider ships a new entry, what does the pull request do? Prices are edited in place either way.
